messages:
Aisha Khan: Quickstart refresh draft pushed. Focus: make "hello-world" minimal, remove legacy auth examples, add a tiny in-browser sandbox link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891
Tom Li: Checking. Do we want both a curl and SDK example? My take: keep one tiny curl (single request) and the SDK example as primary. The curl should be explicitly labeled as "smoke test only".
Priya Rao: Agreed. Also we should show how to load token from a file for Docker and note the security caveat. I'll add a short snippet showing mounting a token: 
```
# run (quickstart)
docker run -v $(pwd)/redwood.token:/run/secrets/redwood.token \
  -e REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE=/run/secrets/redwood.token my-hello-app
```
And a one-liner to cat the file in examples for clarity.
Aisha Khan: Nice. I also added a tiny migration table for devs coming from SDK v4: function name diffs and token env var rename. Kept it to 3 rows.
Tom Li: Small nit on wording: don't call it "API_KEY" anywhere in the quickstart, use REDWOOD_TOKEN consistently. Also, in the JS snippet use `await client.responses.create(...)` and show destructured fields instead of printing the whole object.
Priya Rao: Good catch. I'll update to `const { output } = await client.responses.create({ model: 'open-llama-7b', input: 'Hi' })` in the example. Also added a callout: "Streaming is disabled for trial accounts; you will receive the full response instead."
ci-bot: Linkcheck: found 1 broken internal link (examples/old-quickstart.md). Docs build: warning about Image alt text missing for quickstart diagram.
Aisha Khan: Fixed the link and added alt text. I also swapped the long multi-service docker-compose demo for a single container example with a comment linking to the dedicated deployment guide for advanced setups.
Tom Li: Reviewer request: @Priya can you sanity-check the Docker and token-file example? @Aisha can you add a short CodeSandbox embed URL under the "Try it in browser" section? Keep it lightweight (no server-side secrets).
Priya Rao: Reviewed. Docker snippet looks good. I changed the path to `/etc/secrets/redwood.token` to align with our other docs and added a note about using KMS for production.
Aisha Khan: Added CodeSandbox embed (https://codesandbox.io/s/redwood-quickstart-example-xyz). It's a read-only sandbox that simulates the SDK call with a fake token and clearly marks it as demo-only.
Tom Li: LGTM. One last thing: update the changelog entry under docs changelog (v1.18.3) so release notes pick this up.
Aisha Khan: Done. Merging after CI green.
ci-bot: All checks passed. Merge performed by Aisha Khan.
Aisha Khan: Follow-up: open issue to add an interactive streaming demo for paid tiers. Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2130
Tom Li: Thanks everyone, this should make onboarding smoother. :rocket:
